meta.title: Can we decide together without pretending to agree? | Ritual of the Unresolved Table
meta.description:
A ritual for a disagreement that will not settle. It offers six steps for listening, naming the difference and choosing without a false consensus.

For Election Day, and any day people who disagree must choose together. It helps us decide without pretending to agree.

A ceremony for minds that understand one another better but still disagree, separating evidence, commitments, authority, and consequences without forcing reconciliation.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/rituals/ritual-of-the-unresolved-table

3:12 II
5:45 III
